summary: Mechanical engineering Ph.D. with experience in CFD-driven HVAC product development, numerical solver development, aerodynamic analysis, and experimental validation. Developed parametric design automation and improved outdoor fan-shroud airflow efficiency through simulation and prototype testing.

rheem.text: Optimized outdoor fan-shroud geometry using CFD; prototype tests demonstrated more than 80% improvement in airflow efficiency (CFM/W) relative to the previous design.
Developed a Python/CadQuery parametric fan-shroud generator, automating CAD geometry and STEP-file creation across product configurations.

ltts.text: Developed a real-time C/C++ HVAC plant model for SiL and HiL applications, coupling FEM-based fluid and thermal solvers with heater and cooler models.

utsa.text: Developed Eulerian-based CFD models of hurricane-wave generation and fluid motion to investigate hydrodynamic loading on coastal bridges.
Developed coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian models to analyze fluid-structure interaction under extreme coastal loading.
